description: Call after writing or editing a dependency file and before committing or installing. Checks every dependency in one pass, including dev and optional groups, where an invented name usually arrives. Exact pinned versions are verified too. Supported: package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, Cargo.toml, go.mod, Gemfile, composer.json, *.csproj / packages.config, pubspec.yaml, mix.exs, Dockerfile, .github/workflows/*.yml.

filename.description: e.g. package.json. Only the base name is used to pick a parser.

model.description: Optional: the model that produced these names (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). With an API key this attests absent names to the public hallucination ledger.

name: hallux_check_manifest
